samples.question: Two panels sit side by side: panel A on the left and panel B on the right. Each panel shows the same four disks -- red, green, blue, and purple -- at the same fixed positions, read left to right. A disk is either hollow (an outline ring) or filled (a solid disk). Exactly one disk changes its fill state between panel A and panel B; all other disks are identical in the two panels. Which colour is the single changed disk? Answer with its colour: red, green, blue, or purple.
